description: Price each shipment in the logistics tracker using weight brackets per delivery zone (a range / inequality join). A bracket applies when shipment.zone = bracket.zone and min_kg <= weight_kg and (max_kg IS NULL or weight_kg < max_kg); min_kg is inclusive, max_kg is exclusive, NULL max_kg means unbounded. Shipments with no matching bracket must be kept with shipping_cost = NULL and is_unpriced = TRUE. Each shipment appears exactly once. Output columns: shipment_id (INT64), zone (STRING), weight_kg (FLOAT64), shipping_cost (FLOAT64), is_unpriced (BOOL). Sort by shipment_id.

weight_kg.description: Billable weight; NULL when not yet weighed

max_kg.description: Upper bound, exclusive; NULL = no upper bound

edge_cases: Weight exactly on a bracket boundary (5.0, 20.0) belongs to the upper bracket only
Unbounded top bracket has max_kg NULL
Zone with no brackets yields an unpriced shipment, not a dropped row
Shipment with NULL weight is unpriced
common_failure_modes: FM1: BETWEEN min_kg AND max_kg matches two brackets on boundary weights, duplicating shipments
FM5: weight_kg < max_kg is NULL for the unbounded bracket, so heavy shipments lose their price
FM1: INNER JOIN silently drops shipments in zones without brackets
